rule: dark.tokens.json and light.tokens.json MUST contain exactly this key set, no more, no less. print.tokens.json is a separate smaller namespace (print-*) and is not required to match.
validation: unknown token (not in requiredKeys, not print-*) fails
missing required key in either theme fails
duplicate key within one file fails (JSON parser already guarantees this)
every CSS var referenced by any component must resolve in tokens.css for both [data-theme=dark] and [data-theme=light]
